result.document_summary: A mid-document fragment of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 3, Business Regulations) from a code-publisher page, covering alarm-user enforcement and appeals (Div. 37) and cardroom licensing and regulation (Div. 39).
result.notes: This part contains only alarm-system enforcement/appeal provisions and cardroom licensing and operating rules. None of it addresses rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. The page URL refers to a Division 11 prohibition on algorithmic rent price-fixing (SDMC 98.1103), but that text is not in this part of the document, so no rule is extracted.
